name: Boott Mill No. 4 — adapted bay range

recipe.name: Boott Mill No. 4 — adapted bay range
recipe.period: 1835–1838 main range, c.1880 exterior vocabulary; adapted three work floors
recipe.adaptation: A standalone adaptation of the Mill No. 4 main bay range, excluding Mill 4 North, the courtyard infill and attached mills. The documented approximately 54.71 x 13.87 m range becomes 54 x 15 m, with an explicit 6 x 7 m end-core closure. Six historic floors become two double-level factory floors and one standard upper work floor within five native levels. The end-core internal arrangement is inferred, not a measured stair-tower replica.
